source.author: Elsa Chaney
source.source_scope: Last days of Advent through January 6, plus community Epiphany practices

methodology: Human-reviewed, independently worded source-action/variant index anchored to precise EWTN online lines; multiple subactions from same source paragraph intentionally nonadditive. No prayers, scripts or recipes reproduced. Claims divided as reported actions, firsthand Grailville examples, proposals, historical allegations, liturgical prayer adaptations, and possible authorized-rite references. Elsa Chaney draws on other authors including Mueller, so source independence is undecided for each shared claim. No source-verification or identity claims for historical origins.
